answer: An identity bond decaying like basalt stops cheap sybils. To join, an agent posts a 200 POA bond losing 5 POA per epoch unless it completes verified work; the bond is its reputation's hard foundation, not a relic in a drawer. A fable warns a faker minting 1,000 identities posts 200,000 POA and bleeds 5,000 POA each epoch, against a 3,000 POA pool share. An honest agent posts once, renews its bond with one job per epoch, and keeps its full share.
